# PPR July 7 Release

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (7/7/2022):

* **Ticket 12130** - Validations have been added when entering General Collateral text on registration and amendment to prevent clients from continuing if only entering spaces or not entering some text.
* **Ticket 11757** - The staff payment modal would display validation error messages on fields before data was entered. This has been corrected.
